runtimeInvariants: CLAIMED billing reconciliation work can be reclaimed only after a stale lease threshold and below the bounded attempt cap.
Attempts at or above the cap move to UNCERTAIN rather than being silently retried or promoted.
RECONCILED requires a non-empty canonical payment receipt reference.
Only the worker owning the current CLAIMED lease may finish the event.
RETRYABLE releases the lease and schedules a bounded next attempt.
Webhook or reconciliation state never grants fulfillment unlock authority.
